title: DEF CON 17 - Deviant Ollam - Packing and the Friendly Skies
summary: Deviant Ollam's DEF CON 17 talk explains how legally checking a firearm in luggage can be the most secure way to fly with valuable tech. It covers firearm transport rules and luggage locks.
why: HN cites it as a famous talk on luggage security whenever TSA keys or baggage theft come up.

quote.text: First heard about this at DEFCON at a great presentation titled: Packing and the Friendly Skies.
